name: OpenID Connect
description: Sign in through an OpenID Connect identity provider you run, such as Authentik, Keycloak or Authelia. The server verifies every ID token against the issuer you type here.

fields.label: Issuer URL
fields.help: The issuer your identity provider names in its discovery document, e.g. https://auth.example.com/application/o/obelo/.

fields.label: Client ID
fields.help: The client you registered for this server. Register exactly one redirect URI with it: this server's origin followed by /sign-in/callback, e.g. https://obelo.example.com/sign-in/callback — the same scheme, host, port and path your browser uses to reach the server, and no wildcards.

fields.label: Client secret
fields.help: Leave empty for a public client.

fields.label: Scopes
fields.help: Space-separated. openid is always asked for. The server re-checks each person's groups every day with the refresh token the provider issues; add offline_access if your provider issues one only for that scope.
